newsitem.title: UK: UK cargo wholesaler ICM drops inbound rates ex-US.
newsitem.headline: UK cargo wholesaler ICM drops inbound rates ex-US.

text.p: UK air cargo wholesaler International Cargo Marketing (ICM) said it has reduced its inbound Los Angeles-London Heathrow 500 kg- and 1,000 kg-plus rates by five U.S. cents per kg immediately.
Jonathan Murdoch, spokesman for ICM, a British Midland sister company, told Reuters that this followed ICM's success in California in "getting some very good rates from United Airlines UAL.N ".
He added that similar competitive rates from the UK to Los Angeles, based mainly on Virgin Atlantic VA.CN flights should be announced later this month.
He said the new ICM Los Angeles-London Heathrow airport-to-airport per kg rate for UK import agents for a 500 kg-plus shipment was 1.45 stg and was 1.40 stg for 1,000 kg-plus.
Other inbound rates from Los Angeles remain at 1.60 stg for below 45 kg, 1.50 for 100 kg-plus and 1.45 for 300 kg-plus.
